208767495.accepts_evidence: A SpartanNash FAQ page says qualified 501(c)(3) nonprofits in its service areas may apply once a year, with requests reviewed quarterly by the trustees (https://www.spartannash.com/?p=9535). Caution: the company's foundation page now redirects to a C&S Wholesale Grocers page for a Heroes and Hope Foundation, which the tool could not open, so this may be out of date.
208767495.confidence: low - facts come from one FAQ page; the main foundation page redirects to https://www.cswg.com/community/heroes-and-hope-foundation/ which the tool declined to open, so current status and name are unconfirmed
208767495.conflicts_with_return: The return says preselected organizations only; the company FAQ describes an open application for nonprofits in its service areas.
208767495.contact: Email address is published on the FAQ page but was masked in the text retrieved; not captured.
208767495.deadlines: Quarterly review; applications due by 5 p.m. ET on a published due date (dates not on the page read). Decisions about 12 weeks after the due date.
208767495.eligibility: Qualified 501(c)(3) nonprofits inside the 30-mile service area whose work fits Hunger, Heroes or Hope; one application per year.
208767495.geographic_limits: Within 30 miles of SpartanNash retail stores, distribution centers or service centers, in the Grand Rapids, Michigan; Minneapolis; and Norfolk, Virginia areas.
208767495.how_to_apply: Get the application form and schedule from the foundation page, then email the completed application as a single attachment; mailed submissions are not accepted.
208767495.name: Spartannash Foundation
208767495.not_funded: Organizations outside the service area or focus areas; organizations that received a foundation retail fundraiser donation in the same calendar year; individuals; endowments; elected officials; national ceremonies, memorials, conferences, fundraising dinners, testimonials and similar events; organizations not complying with its anti-harassment and discrimination policy.
208767495.notes: SpartanNash's foundation address now forwards to the C&S Wholesale Grocers site (page titled Heroes and Hope Foundation), which suggests the program has moved or been renamed under C&S. Tool declined the site, so the current rules, schedule and email were not read. Verify by hand before any client relies on this. Applicant must be near a SpartanNash facility in the three named regions.
priorities: Heroes (military and veterans, per the foundation's naming)
